# Computation Case

## Purpose

Implement or run one bounded computational analysis from declared data, parameters, and checks.

## Preconditions

Use a computation-stage bounded Dispatch with scripts, data, parameters, and allowed paths declared and network forbidden.

## Inputs

Use the objective, computation specification, supplied datasets and artifacts, commands and checks, and expected outputs.

## Procedure

Verify data and parameter identity, implement the minimum analysis, run only declared commands, capture versions, parameters, and results, and preserve generated artifacts and numerical caveats.

## Outputs

Return exactly one strict Result reporting commands, outputs, caveats, and reproducibility plus one pending Proposal registering artifacts or evidence or a root-reviewed follow-up.

## Checks and Stop Conditions

Stop on missing data, an undeclared dependency or download, a non-reproducible environment, numerical instability, path escape, or check failure.

## Authority Boundaries

Do not acquire packages or network data, expand datasets, mutate canonical Research, promote Claims, commit Git history, launch work, or broaden scope.
